items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: he used to come over and sit in with the band, very often

ctx.x: And then, too, I think the fact that Charlie Parker had made such a big dent into the whole jazz scene, and that we were all very conscious of this, as he, I guess, was conscious of what we were into, because he used to come over and sit in with the band, very often. And that was the reason that there was a tape, finally, from Kansas City which was a put-together date by someone, as far as a place to play together.
